svg.title: Slug Factory: elapsed factoring time on NVIDIA DGX Sparks

cc:Work.dc:title: Slug Factory: elapsed factoring time on NVIDIA DGX Sparks
cc:Work.dc:description: One machine: 100–115 digits, three-run means. Four machines: 120–140 digits. 20 CPU workers per machine.
